source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of constructors and destructors (PDF 58).

items: Constructor: ek khaas function jo class ke variables ko shuru ki value deta (initialize karta) hai. Python mein __init__() method object bante hi us ki properties set karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab constructor ki misaal ek hi line mein chhapti hai (class Car: def __init__... ); aise SyntaxError aata hai. Sahi shakal oopar hai.

items: Destructor: __del__() method tab chalta hai jab object delete hota hai. Yeh cleanup (safai) ke kaam aata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke print mein "is being deleted . " se pehle quote nahi (self.color ,  is being deleted . ")); aise SyntaxError aata hai. Sahi: print("Car with color", self.color, "is being deleted.").

Yeh destructor object delete hone par message print karta hai, jo batata hai ke cleanup ho raha hai. Maslan c = Car("red") ke baad del c likhne par "Car with color red is being deleted . " print hota hai.
Wazahat: Car class color attribute ke saath banti hai, aur jab us ka koi object delete hota hai to message batata hai ke us color wali car hatayi ja rahi hai.

blocks.explanation: __init__ object banne par chalta hai; __del__ object delete hone par (maslan del car se ya program ke aakhir mein).

blocks.text: Object bante hi constructor __init__ chalta hai aur del se delete hote waqt destructor __del__. color badal kar Run karein aur dekhein dono messages kis tarteeb (order) mein aate hain.

color = "red"
class Car:
    def __init__(self, color):
        self.color = color
        print("Constructor: car with color", self.color, "created.")
    def __del__(self):
        print("Destructor: car with color", self.color, "is being deleted.")
my_car = Car(color)
print("Car is in use. Color:", my_car.color)
del my_car
print("Program finished.")

items: __init__: object bante waqt; __del__: object delete hote waqt.
